description: A component that automatically adjusts its layout (height, position, or padding) to prevent the on-screen keyboard from covering input fields.

data.name: behavior
data.description: Defines how the view reacts to the keyboard appearance.

data.name: enabled
data.description: Enables or disables the KeyboardAvoidingView behavior.

data.name: keyboardVerticalOffset
data.description: Distance between the top of the screen and the React Native view, useful when using headers or navigation bars.

data.name: contentContainerStyle
data.description: Style applied to the inner container when behavior is set to 'position'.

data.name: style
data.description: Applies layout and visual styling to the KeyboardAvoidingView.

data.name: Android Behavior
data.description: Typically requires 'height' behavior and proper windowSoftInputMode settings.

data.name: Set behavior explicitly
data.description: Always define behavior to ensure consistent keyboard handling on both platforms.

data.name: Combine with ScrollView
data.description: Use KeyboardAvoidingView with ScrollView for long forms.

data.name: Missing behavior prop
data.description: Not setting behavior may cause inputs to be hidden by the keyboard.

data.name: Incorrect offset
data.description: Wrong keyboardVerticalOffset can cause layout misalignment.

example.title: Basic KeyboardAvoidingView Example
example.description: A simple login form that stays visible when the keyboard opens.
